spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (मोदते)
To rejoice, to be glad.
r. 10th cl. (मोदयति)
To mix, to blend, to unite.

f. (-दा)
Happiness, joy.
E.
मुद to be happy, अङ् and टाप् affs.

f. (मुद् मुत्)
1 Pleasure, delight, joy.
2 Intoxication, phrensy.
3 A wife.
E.
मुद to be pleased, aff. क्विप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Pleased, happy.
E.
मुदा, and अन्वित possessed of.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Pleased, delighted.
n. (-तं)
Pleasure, happiness.
E.
मुद to rejoice, aff. क्त.

m. (-रः)
1 A cloud.
2 A lover, a libertine.
E.
मुद to be pleased, Uṇādi aff. किरच्.

f. (-दी)
Moonlight.
E.
मुद to please, affs. क and ङीष्.

m. (-द्गः)
1 A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus mungo.)
2 A cover, as a lid or cloth.
E.
मुदि to please, Uṇādi aff. ग.

f. (-र्णी)
A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus trilobus.)
E.
मुद्ग P. mungo, पर्ण a leaf, ङीष् aff.

m. (-भुक्)
A horse.
E.
मुद्ग kidney-bean, and भुज् who eats; also मुद्गभोजिन् m. (-जी)

m. (-रः)
1 A mallet, a mace, a weapon formed like a carpenter's hammer.
2 A staff, armed with iron, and larger at the lower extremity, used for breaking clods of earth, &c.
3 A carpenter's hammer.
4 A sort of flower, said to be a kind of jasmine, perhaps Jasminum zambac, the wild variety.
E.
मुट् pleasure, गॄ to swallow or destroy, aff. अच्; also with र changed to ल, मुद्गल.

m. (-ष्ठः)
A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus lobatus.)
E.
मुद्ग P. mungo, स्था to stay, to resemble, aff. क; also with कन् added, मुद्गष्ठक.

f. (-द्रा)
1 A seal, a signet.
2 A seal ring.
3 The mark of a seal or similar impression, a stamp, a print, &c.
4 A mode of intertwining the fingers during religious worship.
E.
मुद to please, (by it,) Uṇādi aff. रक्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Stamped, sealed.
f. (-ता)
A mint.
E.
मुद्रा a seal, and अङ्कित marked.

f. (-का)
A sealed or signed paper.
E.
मुद्र a seal, and कन् aff., fem. form.

Marked, struck, stamped.
3 Contracted, closed, sealed up.
4 Unblown, (as a flower.)
E.
मुद्रा a seal, and इतच् aff.
